records.literal_gloss: For the director, on mahalath, a maskil of David.

en.L: For the director: on mahalath. A maskil of David.
en.B: For the music director. On mahalath. A maskil of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To the tune "Mahalath". A song by David to teach and give insight.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : sur mahalath. Un maskil de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Sur mahalath. Un maskil de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Sur l’air « Mahalath ». Un chant de David pour enseigner et faire comprendre.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: juu ya mahalathi. Maskili ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Juu ya mahalathi. Maskili ya Daudi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Kwa sauti ya wimbo "Mahalathi". Wimbo wa Daudi wa kufundisha na kutia ufahamu.

es.L: Al director del coro: sobre mahalat. Un masquil de David.
es.B: Al director del coro. Sobre mahalat. Un masquil de David.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Con la melodía «Mahalat». Un canto de David para enseñar y dar sabiduría.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: theo [điệu] Ma-ha-lát. [Một] bài Mát-kin của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Theo điệu Ma-ha-lát. Bài Mát-kin của Đa-vít.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Theo điệu “Ma-ha-lát”. Bài ca của Đa-vít để dạy dỗ và giúp hiểu biết.

ko.L: 지휘자를 위하여. 마할랏에 맞추어. 다윗의 마스길.
ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 마할랏에 맞추어. 다윗의 마스길.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해. ‘마할랏’이라는 곡조에 맞추어. 다윗이 지은, 가르침과 깨달음을 주는 노래.

pt.L: Para o regente: sobre maalate. Masquil de Davi.
pt.B: Para o mestre de música. Sobre maalate. Masquil de Davi.
pt.R: Para quem dirige a música. Na melodia "Maalate". Uma canção de Davi, para ensinar e dar entendimento.

am.R: ለመዘምራን አለቃ። «ማሐላት» በሚባለው ዜማ። ለማስተማርና ማስተዋልን ለመስጠት ዳዊት የዘመረው መዝሙር።

hi.L: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए: महलत पर। दाऊद का मस्कील।
hi.B: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। महलत पर। दाऊद का मस्कील।
hi.R: गायक-मंडली के अगुवे के लिए। "महलत" की धुन पर। दाऊद का एक गीत, जो शिक्षा और समझ देने के लिए है।

ru.L: Руководителю хора: на махалат. Маскиль Давида.
ru.B: Руководителю хора. На махалат. Маскиль Давида.
ru.R: Для руководителя музыкантов. На мотив «Махалат». Песня Давида, чтобы учить.

uk.L: Для диригента: на махалат. Маскіл Давида.
uk.B: Для диригента хору. На махалат. Маскіл Давида.
uk.R: Для того, хто керує співом. На мелодію «Махалат». Пісня Давида, щоб навчати й давати розуміння.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: mahalath: a musical term whose meaning is unknown
decisions.reason: The word (machalat) appears only here and in the title of Psalm 88. It may be the name of a tune, or come from a word for sickness or sorrow; its meaning is lost.

decisions.choice: maskil: probably a skillful or instructive song
decisions.reason: As in 32:1, the word (maskil) comes from a verb meaning to be wise or to give insight. Its exact sense as a kind of song is no longer known.

decisions.choice: To the tune "Mahalath"
decisions.reason: Readable takes the term as a tune name, as with other such terms (45:1).

decisions.choice: a song to teach and give insight
decisions.reason: Readable gives the likely sense of the term, as in 42:1.

decisions.choice: "mahalathi" kept as a name at every level; Readable reads it as the name of a tune, as the English Readable does
decisions.reason: No one knows what this musical term means. Swahili keeps the word with a Swahili ending, and the uncertainty in the English decision carries over.

decisions.choice: sobre mahalat (L, B); Con la melodía «Mahalat» (R)
decisions.reason: Mahalath is a musical term whose meaning is unknown. Literal and Balanced keep it as a name; Readable takes it as the name of a tune, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Ma-ha-lát" kept as a name at every level
decisions.reason: No one knows what the word means (see the meaning decision); every level keeps it as a name, and Readable calls it a tune, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "마할랏에 맞추어" (L, B), the Hebrew word kept; Readable "‘마할랏’이라는 곡조에 맞추어"
decisions.reason: The meaning of the word is unknown (meaning decision m3); Korean keeps it as a name and Readable takes it as a tune, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: sobre maalate (L, B); Na melodia "Maalate" (R)
decisions.reason: The unknown musical term (m3) is kept as a name in Portuguese spelling, "maalate", as the book keeps "seminite" and "alamote"; Readable takes it as a tune name, as the English does and as Portuguese does with "Lírios" in 45:1. Psalm 88:1 should use the same form.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: mahalath as the name "ማሐላት" (Literal, Balanced; Readable «ማሐላት» በሚባለው ዜማ, as the English)
decisions.reason: Its meaning is lost (see the meaning decision), so it stays a name. The same heading word returns in Psalm 88:1, which should use the same form.

decisions.choice: महलत
decisions.reason: Mahalath is a musical term whose meaning is unknown (m3). Hindi keeps it as a name, transcribed from the Hebrew; Readable takes it as a tune, as the English does.

decisions.choice: махалат (L, B); на мотив «Махалат» (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning of the term is lost; as the poetry note says for such terms, Literal and Balanced keep it as a name and Readable takes it as a tune, as the English levels do, with the English decision's uncertainty.

source.text: אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽ֝שְׁחִ֗יתוּ וְהִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עָ֝֗וֶל אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־טֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: Says [the] fool in his heart, There is no God. They have acted corruptly and done abominable injustice; there is none who does good.

en.L: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." \q They have acted corruptly, \q and they have done abominable injustice; \q there is none who does good.
en.B: Fools tell themselves, "There is no God." \q They are rotten through and through; \q their wrongdoing is detestable. \q Not one of them does good.
en.R: Foolish people think, "There is no God." \q They are evil, and they do terrible, unfair things. \q None of them does what is good.

fr.L: L’insensé dit dans son cœur : « Il n’y a pas de Dieu. » \q Ils ont agi de façon corrompue, \q et ils ont commis une injustice abominable ; \q il n’y a personne qui fasse le bien.
fr.B: Les insensés se disent : « Il n’y a pas de Dieu. » \q Ils sont pourris jusqu’au fond ; \q leur injustice est odieuse. \q Pas un seul d’entre eux ne fait le bien.
fr.R: Les gens insensés pensent : « Il n’y a pas de Dieu. » \q Ils sont mauvais, et ils font des choses horribles et injustes. \q Aucun d’eux ne fait ce qui est bien.

sw.L: Mpumbavu anasema moyoni mwake, "Hakuna Mungu." \q Wametenda kwa upotovu, \q na wamefanya udhalimu wa kuchukiza; \q hakuna anayetenda mema.
sw.B: Wapumbavu hujiambia, "Hakuna Mungu." \q Wameoza kabisa; \q udhalimu wao ni wa kuchukiza. \q Hakuna hata mmoja wao anayetenda mema.
sw.R: Watu wapumbavu hufikiri, "Hakuna Mungu." \q Ni waovu, nao hufanya mambo ya kutisha yasiyo ya haki. \q Hakuna hata mmoja wao anayetenda yaliyo mema.

es.L: El necio dice en su corazón: «No hay Dios». \q Han actuado de manera corrupta, \q y han cometido injusticia abominable; \q no hay quien haga el bien.
es.B: Los necios se dicen a sí mismos: «No hay Dios». \q Están podridos por completo; \q su maldad es detestable. \q Ni uno de ellos hace el bien.
es.R: La gente necia piensa: «No hay Dios». \q Son malos, y hacen cosas terribles e injustas. \q Ninguno de ellos hace lo que es bueno.

vi.L: Kẻ ngu dại nói trong lòng: “Không có Đức Chúa Trời.” \q Chúng đã hành động bại hoại, \q và chúng đã làm điều bất công ghê tởm; \q không có ai làm điều thiện.
vi.B: Kẻ ngu dại tự nhủ: “Không có Đức Chúa Trời.” \q Chúng thối nát đến tận cùng; \q việc gian ác của chúng thật đáng ghê tởm. \q Không một ai trong chúng làm điều lành.
vi.R: Kẻ ngu dại nghĩ rằng: “Không có Đức Chúa Trời.” \q Chúng gian ác, và chúng làm những điều bất công khủng khiếp. \q Không ai trong chúng làm điều tốt.

ko.L: 어리석은 자가 그의 마음속으로 말한다. “하나님은 없다.” \q 그들은 썩었고, \q 가증한 불의를 행하였다. \q 선을 행하는 자가 없다.
ko.B: 어리석은 자들은 속으로 “하나님은 없다” 하고 말한다. \q 그들은 속속들이 썩었고, \q 그들이 저지른 불의는 역겹다. \q 선을 행하는 사람은 하나도 없다.
ko.R: 어리석은 사람들은 “하나님은 없다” 하고 생각한다. \q 그들은 악하고, 끔찍하고 부당한 일을 저지른다. \q 그들 가운데 선한 일을 하는 사람은 아무도 없다.

pt.L: O insensato diz no seu coração: "Não há Deus." \q Agiram de modo corrupto, \q e cometeram injustiça abominável; \q não há ninguém que pratique o bem.
pt.B: Os insensatos dizem a si mesmos: "Deus não existe." \q Estão podres por inteiro; \q a sua injustiça é detestável. \q Ninguém faz o que é bom.
pt.R: As pessoas sem juízo pensam: "Deus não existe." \q Elas são más e fazem coisas terríveis e injustas. \q Nenhuma delas faz o que é bom.

am.L: ባለጌ በልቡ፦ «አምላክ የለም» ይላል። \q ተበላሹ፤ \q አስጸያፊ ግፍንም ሠሩ፤ \q መልካምን የሚያደርግ የለም።
am.B: ባለጌዎች «አምላክ የለም» ብለው ለራሳቸው ይናገራሉ። \q ፈጽመው ተበላሽተዋል፤ \q ግፋቸውም አስጸያፊ ነው። \q ከእነርሱ መልካም የሚያደርግ አንድ እንኳ የለም።
am.R: ባለጌ ሰዎች «አምላክ የለም» ብለው ያስባሉ። \q ክፉዎች ናቸው፤ አሰቃቂና ፍትሕ የጎደለው ነገርም ያደርጋሉ። \q ከእነርሱ መልካም የሚያደርግ የለም።

hi.L: मूर्ख अपने मन में कहता है, "कोई परमेश्वर नहीं।" \q उन्होंने भ्रष्ट काम किए हैं, \q और उन्होंने घिनौना अन्याय किया है; \q कोई भलाई करनेवाला नहीं।
hi.B: मूर्ख अपने आप से कहते हैं, "कोई परमेश्वर नहीं है।" \q वे पूरी तरह बिगड़ चुके हैं; \q उनका अन्याय घिनौना है। \q उनमें से कोई भलाई नहीं करता।
hi.R: मूर्ख लोग सोचते हैं, "परमेश्वर है ही नहीं।" \q वे दुष्ट हैं, और भयानक, अन्यायपूर्ण काम करते हैं। \q उनमें से कोई भी भलाई नहीं करता।

ru.L: Говорит безумец в сердце своём: «Нет Бога.» \q Они развращены, \q и совершили мерзкую неправду; \q нет делающего добро.
ru.B: Безумцы говорят себе: «Бога нет.» \q Они прогнили насквозь; \q их неправда отвратительна. \q Ни один из них не делает добра.
ru.R: Глупые люди думают: «Бога нет.» \q Они злые и делают ужасные, несправедливые вещи. \q Никто из них не делает добра.

uk.L: Безумний каже в своєму серці: «Немає Бога.» \q Вони зіпсувалися \q і вчинили огидну неправду; \q немає того, хто чинить добро.
uk.B: Безумні кажуть собі: «Бога немає.» \q Вони зіпсовані наскрізь; \q їхня кривда огидна. \q Жоден із них не чинить добра.
uk.R: Нерозумні люди думають: «Немає Бога.» \q Вони злі й чинять жахливе й несправедливе. \q Жоден із них не робить доброго.

decisions.choice: Psalm 14 and Romans 3
decisions.reason: This psalm is almost the same as Psalm 14. It says "God" where Psalm 14 has "the LORD", has "injustice" for "deeds" in this verse, and has a different verse 6. Paul quotes verses 2-4 in Romans 3:10-12 to show that all people are under sin.

decisions.choice: the fool: one who lives without regard for God
decisions.reason: As in 14:1, the fool (naval) is not slow of mind but morally senseless, living as if God does not matter (1 Samuel 25:25).

decisions.choice: There is no God: living as if God will not act
decisions.reason: To say something "in the heart" is to think it. As in 14:1, the fool is living as if God will never see or judge, not arguing about whether he exists.

decisions.choice: injustice: wrong done to others
decisions.reason: The word ('awel) is injustice, unfair dealing. Psalm 14:1 has "deeds" here.

decisions.choice: Fools ... they (B); Foolish people (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes one figure ("he", "his") who stands for everyone who acts this way. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, as Psalm 10 does with "the wicked", which includes men and women alike; Literal keeps the Hebrew singular.

decisions.choice: "l'insensé" for naval (Literal); "les insensés" (Balanced), "les gens insensés" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The naval is not slow of mind but morally senseless, living as if God does not matter (meaning decision m2). "Insensé" says this; "fou" would suggest madness. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "kẻ ngu dại" at every level, with "chúng" after it
decisions.reason: The fool here is one who lives as if God did not matter (see the meaning decision), not someone lacking intelligence; "kẻ ngu dại" is the terms note's word for the fool, and "chúng" covers the whole group the verse goes on to describe.

decisions.choice: "어리석은 자" (L, B), "어리석은 사람" (R) for the Hebrew word for fool
decisions.reason: The word names one who lives without regard for God (meaning decision m2), a moral fault, not low intelligence; "어리석은" carries that in Korean. "미련한 자" is kept for the fool of Proverbs (kesil).

decisions.choice: the Portuguese of Psalm 14:1, with "injustiça"
decisions.reason: This psalm repeats Psalm 14 (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of 14:1, which already follows Romans 3:10-12; only "injustiça" (L, B) and "injustas" (R) change, where this psalm has "injustice" for "deeds" (m4).

decisions.choice: the Amharic of Psalm 14 copied at each level where the Hebrew is the same, with this psalm's line breaks; here "injustice" ('awel) is "ግፍ" where 14:1 has "deeds" ("ሥራ")
decisions.reason: Psalm 53 repeats Psalm 14 (see the meaning decision), so the two read alike. Where the Hebrew differs (God for the LORD, injustice for deeds, turned back for turned aside, the whole of verse 6), the Amharic follows this psalm's Hebrew.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 14:1 at each level
decisions.reason: Psalm 53 is Psalm 14 again (m1). Where the Hebrew is the same, each level keeps the Hindi of Psalm 14:1, which itself keeps the wording Romans 3 quotes.

decisions.choice: घिनौना अन्याय (L); उनका अन्याय घिनौना है (B); अन्यायपूर्ण (R)
decisions.reason: Where Psalm 14:1 has "abominable deeds", this psalm has "abominable injustice" (m4), so the Hindi differs from Psalm 14 here.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 14:1 in this translation
decisions.reason: Psalm 53 is Psalm 14 with "God" for "the LORD" and a changed verse 6. Where the Hebrew is the same, each level copies Psalm 14's Russian ("безумец", "нет делающего добро", as Romans 3:12), set in the lines the English gives Psalm 53.

decisions.choice: неправда (L, B); несправедливые (R)
decisions.reason: Psalm 14:1 has "deed" ('alilah) where this verse has "injustice" ('awel), so the wording differs from Psalm 14 here.

source.text: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל־בְּנֵ֫י אָדָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵ֗שׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: God from heaven looks down on [the] children of humankind to see [whether] there is [one] who has insight, who seeks God.

en.L: God from heaven looks down on the {{gender:children of humankind|sons of men}} \q to see whether there is [anyone] who has insight, \q who seeks God.
en.B: From heaven God looks down on the human race \q to see whether anyone is wise, \q anyone who is looking for God.
en.R: God watches all people from heaven. \q He wants to see if anyone is wise and wants to know God.

fr.L: Dieu, du haut des cieux, se penche sur les {{gender:enfants des humains|fils des hommes}} \q pour voir s’il y a [quelqu’un] qui ait de l’intelligence, \q qui cherche Dieu.
fr.B: Du haut du ciel, Dieu se penche sur le genre humain \q pour voir si quelqu’un est sage, \q si quelqu’un cherche Dieu.
fr.R: Du ciel, Dieu regarde tous les gens. \q Il veut voir si quelqu’un est sage et veut connaître Dieu.

sw.L: Mungu kutoka mbinguni anawachungulia wana wa Adamu \q kuona kama yuko [mtu yeyote] mwenye ufahamu, \q anayemtafuta Mungu.
sw.B: Kutoka mbinguni Mungu anaitazama jamii ya wanadamu \q kuona kama yupo mtu mwenye hekima, \q mtu yeyote anayemtafuta Mungu.
sw.R: Mungu anawatazama watu wote kutoka mbinguni. \q Anataka kuona kama yupo mtu mwenye hekima anayetaka kumjua Mungu.

es.L: Dios desde el cielo mira hacia abajo a los {{gender:hijos de la humanidad|hijos de los hombres}} \q para ver si hay [alguien] que tenga entendimiento, \q que busque a Dios.
es.B: Desde el cielo Dios mira a la raza humana \q para ver si hay alguien sabio, \q alguien que esté buscando a Dios.
es.R: Dios observa desde el cielo a todas las personas. \q Quiere ver si hay alguien sabio que quiera conocer a Dios.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời từ trên trời nhìn xuống con cái loài người \q để xem có [ai] hiểu biết, \q có ai tìm kiếm Đức Chúa Trời chăng.
vi.B: Từ trên trời Đức Chúa Trời nhìn xuống loài người \q để xem có ai khôn ngoan, \q có ai đang tìm kiếm Đức Chúa Trời không.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời từ trên trời nhìn xuống mọi người. \q Ngài muốn xem có ai khôn ngoan và muốn biết Đức Chúa Trời không.

ko.L: 하나님께서 하늘에서 {{gender:사람의 자녀들|사람의 아들들}}을 굽어보신다, \q 깨달음이 있는 자가 있는지, \q 하나님을 찾는 자가 [있는지] 보시려고.
ko.B: 하나님께서 하늘에서 사람들을 굽어보시며 \q 지혜로운 사람이 있는지, \q 하나님을 찾는 사람이 있는지 살피신다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 하늘에서 모든 사람을 지켜보신다. \q 지혜롭게 살며 하나님을 알고 싶어 하는 사람이 있는지 보고 싶어 하신다.

pt.L: Deus olha dos céus para os {{gender:filhos da humanidade|filhos dos homens}}, \q para ver se há [alguém] que entenda, \q que busque a Deus.
pt.B: Dos céus Deus olha para a humanidade, \q para ver se há alguém que entenda, \q alguém que busque a Deus.
pt.R: Deus observa todas as pessoas lá do céu. \q Ele quer ver se alguém é sábio e procura a Deus.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ ወደ ሰው ልጆች ይመለከታል፤ \q የሚያስተውል፣ \q እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልግ ይኖር እንደ ሆነ ለማየት።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ ወደ ሰው ዘር ሁሉ ይመለከታል፤ \q ጠቢብ ሰው፣ \q እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈልግ ሰው ይገኝ እንደ ሆነ ለማየት።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ ሆኖ ሰዎችን ሁሉ ይመለከታል። \q ጥበበኛ የሆነና እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅ የሚፈልግ ሰው ይኖር እንደ ሆነ ለማየት ይፈልጋል።

hi.L: परमेश्वर स्वर्ग से {{gender:मनुष्य की सन्तान|मनुष्य के पुत्रों}} पर नीचे दृष्टि करते हैं \q यह देखने के लिए कि क्या कोई समझनेवाला है, \q कोई परमेश्वर को खोजनेवाला।
hi.B: स्वर्ग से परमेश्वर मानवजाति पर नीचे दृष्टि करते हैं \q यह देखने के लिए कि क्या कोई बुद्धिमान है, \q कोई जो परमेश्वर को खोजता हो।
hi.R: परमेश्वर स्वर्ग से सब लोगों को देखते हैं। \q वे देखना चाहते हैं कि क्या कोई समझदार है, जो परमेश्वर को जानना चाहता हो।

ru.L: Бог с небес смотрит вниз на {{gender:детей человеческих|сынов человеческих}}, \q чтобы увидеть, есть ли [кто-нибудь] понимающий, \q ищущий Бога.
ru.B: С небес Бог смотрит на род человеческий, \q чтобы увидеть, есть ли кто-нибудь разумный, \q кто ищет Бога.
ru.R: Бог с небес смотрит на всех людей. \q Он хочет увидеть, есть ли хоть кто-то мудрый, кто хочет знать Бога.

uk.L: Бог із неба дивиться на {{gender:дітей людських|синів людських}}, \q щоб побачити, чи є [хтось], хто розуміє, \q хто шукає Бога.
uk.B: З неба Бог дивиться на людський рід, \q щоб побачити, чи є хтось мудрий, \q хтось, хто шукає Бога.
uk.R: Бог спостерігає з неба за всіма людьми. \q Він хоче побачити, чи є хтось мудрий, хто хоче пізнати Бога.

decisions.choice: God: where Psalm 14 has the LORD
decisions.reason: Psalms 42-83 often say "God" ('elohim) where other psalms use the divine name. Psalm 14:2 has "the LORD" here; this psalm has "God" in every place where Psalm 14 has the name. The words here follow the Hebrew of this psalm.

decisions.choice: God looks down to see: as before the flood and at Babel
decisions.reason: As in 14:2: God sees the earth before the flood (Genesis 6:5, 12) and comes down to see the tower of Babel (Genesis 11:5). He looks before he judges.

decisions.choice: who has insight: who acts wisely
decisions.reason: The word (maskil) is the same as the term in the title (verse 1): someone who understands and so acts rightly.

decisions.choice: children of humankind, with "sons of men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in 11:4.

decisions.choice: wants to know God
decisions.reason: Readable says what seeking God means.

decisions.choice: Deus
decisions.reason: As Psalm 14:2 in every word, but "Deus" where Psalm 14 has the divine name (m1), so there is no divine_name span in this psalm.

decisions.choice: Elohim as "እግዚአብሔር" with no divine_name span where 14:2 has {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}; Balanced puts 14:2's clauses in the order of this psalm's lines
decisions.reason: This psalm has God where Psalm 14 has the LORD (see the meaning decision); the Amharic default reads the same, but only the divine name takes the setting.

decisions.choice: "የሰው ልጆች" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: The English offers an inclusive and a traditional wording here. The Amharic word (ሰው, የሰው ልጆች, or the generic singular suffix) already speaks of men and women alike, so there is no second wording to offer and no span (docs/amharic-style.md 7b). This holds for the rest of the psalm.

decisions.choice: परमेश्वर
decisions.reason: The wording is that of Psalm 14:2, but where Psalm 14 has the divine name, this psalm has "God" (m1), so Hindi has परमेश्वर with no divine_name span. The same holds in verses 5 and 7.

decisions.choice: मनुष्य की सन्तान, with मनुष्य के पुत्रों as the alternative
decisions.reason: As the English, Literal gives "children of humankind" by default and the Hebrew's "sons of men" as the alternative, in the form of Psalm 14:2.

decisions.choice: Бог
decisions.reason: The wording of Psalm 14:2, with "Бог" where Psalm 14 has the divine name, as the Hebrew does.

source.text: כֻּלּ֥וֹ סָג֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: All of it has turned back; together they have gone sour; there is none who does good, there is not even one.

en.L: All of it has turned back; together they have gone sour; \q there is none who does good, \q not even one.
en.B: Everyone has turned away; all alike have gone bad. \q No one does good, \q not a single one.
en.R: Everyone has turned away from God. All of them have become rotten. \q No one does what is good. \q Not even one person!

fr.L: Tout cela s’est détourné ; ensemble ils se sont gâtés ; \q il n’y a personne qui fasse le bien, \q pas même un seul.
fr.B: Tous se sont détournés ; tous ensemble ils se sont corrompus. \q Personne ne fait le bien, \q pas un seul.
fr.R: Tout le monde s’est détourné de Dieu. Ils sont tous devenus pourris. \q Personne ne fait ce qui est bien. \q Pas même une seule personne !

sw.L: Wote wamerudi nyuma; pamoja wameharibika; \q hakuna anayetenda mema, \q hakuna hata mmoja.
sw.B: Kila mtu amegeuka; wote kwa pamoja wameoza. \q Hakuna anayetenda mema, \q hata mmoja.
sw.R: Kila mtu amemwacha Mungu. Wote wameoza. \q Hakuna anayetenda yaliyo mema. \q Hakuna hata mtu mmoja!

es.L: Todo él se ha vuelto atrás; a una se han corrompido; \q no hay quien haga el bien, \q ni siquiera uno.
es.B: Todos se han apartado; todos por igual se han echado a perder. \q Nadie hace el bien, \q ni uno solo.
es.R: Todos se han alejado de Dios. Todos se han vuelto malos. \q Nadie hace lo que es bueno. \q ¡Ni una sola persona!

vi.L: Tất cả đều đã quay lui; chúng cùng nhau trở nên hư thối; \q không có ai làm điều thiện, \q dù một người cũng không.
vi.B: Mọi người đều đã quay đi; tất cả đều hư hỏng như nhau. \q Không ai làm điều lành, \q dù chỉ một người cũng không.
vi.R: Mọi người đều đã quay lưng với Đức Chúa Trời. Tất cả đều trở nên thối nát. \q Không ai làm điều tốt. \q Không có lấy một người!

ko.L: 모두가 물러갔고, 함께 썩었다. \q 선을 행하는 자가 없다, \q 하나도 없다.
ko.B: 모두가 등을 돌렸고, 다 함께 타락했다. \q 선을 행하는 사람이 없으니, \q 단 한 사람도 없다.
ko.R: 모두가 하나님을 떠났다. 모두가 썩어 버렸다. \q 선한 일을 하는 사람이 아무도 없다. \q 한 사람도 없다!

pt.L: Toda ela voltou atrás; juntos se estragaram; \q não há ninguém que pratique o bem, \q não há nem mesmo um.
pt.B: Todos se afastaram; todos juntos se estragaram. \q Ninguém faz o que é bom, \q nem um só.
pt.R: Todos se afastaram de Deus. Todos eles se estragaram. \q Ninguém faz o que é bom. \q Nem mesmo uma pessoa!

am.L: ሁሉ ወደ ኋላ ተመለሰ፤ በአንድነት ተበላሹ፤ \q መልካምን የሚያደርግ የለም፤ \q አንድ እንኳ የለም።
am.B: ሁሉም ዘወር አሉ፤ ሁሉም በአንድነት ተበላሹ። \q መልካም የሚያደርግ የለም፤ \q አንድ ብቻ እንኳ የለም።
am.R: ሁሉም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘወር አሉ። ሁሉም ተበላሹ። \q መልካም የሚያደርግ የለም። \q አንድ ሰው እንኳ የለም!

hi.L: सब का सब पीछे हट गया है; सब के सब बिगड़ गए हैं; \q कोई भलाई करनेवाला नहीं, \q एक भी नहीं।
hi.B: सब भटक गए हैं; सब मिलकर बिगड़ गए हैं। \q कोई भला काम नहीं करता, \q एक भी नहीं।
hi.R: सब लोग सही मार्ग से भटक गए हैं। वे सब बिगड़ चुके हैं। \q कोई भलाई नहीं करता। \q एक व्यक्ति भी नहीं!

ru.L: Всё [это] отступило; вместе испортились; \q нет делающего добро, \q нет ни одного.
ru.B: Все отвернулись; все вместе испортились. \q Никто не делает добра, \q нет ни одного.
ru.R: Все они отвернулись от Бога. Все они стали гнилыми. \q Никто не делает добра. \q Нет ни одного человека!

uk.L: Усе це відступило; разом вони скисли; \q немає того, хто чинить добро, \q немає й одного.
uk.B: Усі відвернулися; усі однаково зіпсувалися. \q Ніхто не чинить добра, \q жодного немає.
uk.R: Усі відвернулися від Бога. Усі вони зогнили. \q Ніхто не робить доброго. \q Жодної людини!

decisions.choice: turned back: turned away from God
decisions.reason: The verb (sug) means to move back, to turn away. Psalm 14:3 has a similar word, "turned aside".

decisions.choice: gone sour: become rotten
decisions.reason: As in 14:3, the verb ('alach) is used of what has spoiled and become foul (Job 15:16).

decisions.choice: all of it: the whole human race
decisions.reason: "It" refers to humankind, "the children of humankind" of verse 3, taken as one body.

decisions.choice: from God
decisions.reason: Readable says whom they have turned from (m1).

decisions.choice: All of it
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular "it" of the Hebrew (m3).

decisions.choice: Toda ela voltou atrás
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular of the Hebrew, the human race taken as one body (m3); "ela" refers to "a humanidade" of verse 3. The verb is "turned back" (m1), not the "turned aside" of 14:3, so Literal does not reuse "se desviaram"; the rest of the verse keeps the Portuguese of 14:3.

decisions.choice: "turned back" (sug) as "ወደ ኋላ ተመለሰ" (Literal), "ዘወር አሉ" (Balanced), "ከእግዚአብሔር ዘወር አሉ" (Readable, as Romans 3:12)
decisions.reason: Psalm 14:3 has sur (turned aside), which Romans 3:12 follows; this psalm has sug (turned back), so Literal says so. The rest of the verse keeps 14:3 and Romans 3:12.

decisions.choice: सब का सब पीछे हट गया है
decisions.reason: Psalm 14:3 says "all have turned aside"; this psalm says "all of it has turned back" (m3), so Literal differs from Psalm 14 here. Balanced and Readable, which give the sense, keep the wording of Psalm 14:3 and Romans 3:12.

decisions.choice: Всё [это] отступило
decisions.reason: Psalm 14:3 has "turned aside" (sar) with a plural sense; here the verb is "turned back" (sag) and the subject a singular "all of it", which Literal keeps. Balanced and Readable keep Psalm 14:3's wording.

source.text: הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ פֹּ֤עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not they know, workers of wickedness, eaters of my people [who] eat bread? God they do not call on.

en.L: Do they not know, the workers of wickedness, \q who eat up {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people [as] they eat bread? \q On God they do not call.
en.B: Have they learned nothing, these evildoers? \q They devour {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people as if they were eating bread, \q and they never call on God.
en.R: Do these evil people understand nothing? \q They destroy {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people as easily as they eat a meal. \q They never pray to God.

fr.L: Ne savent-ils pas, ceux qui font le mal, \q qui mangent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple [comme] ils mangent du pain ? \q Dieu, ils ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}invoquent pas.
fr.B: N’ont-ils donc rien appris, ces malfaiteurs ? \q Ils dévorent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple comme on mange du pain, \q et jamais ils n’invoquent Dieu.
fr.R: Ces gens mauvais ne comprennent-ils rien ? \q Ils détruisent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple aussi facilement qu’ils prennent un repas. \q Ils ne prient jamais Dieu.

sw.L: Je, hawajui, watenda maovu, \q wanaokula watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} [kama] wanavyokula mkate? \q Mungu hawamwiti.
sw.B: Je, hawajajifunza chochote, watenda maovu hawa? \q Wanawala watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kama wanaokula mkate, \q wala hawamwiti Mungu kamwe.
sw.R: Je, watu hawa waovu hawaelewi chochote? \q Wanawaangamiza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa urahisi kama wanavyokula chakula. \q Hawamwombi Mungu kamwe.

es.L: ¿No saben los que obran maldad, \q que devoran a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo [como] comen pan? \q A Dios no invocan.
es.B: ¿No han aprendido nada estos malhechores? \q Devoran a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo como si comieran pan, \q y nunca invocan a Dios.
es.R: ¿No entienden nada estos malvados? \q Destruyen a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo con la misma facilidad con que se comen una comida. \q Nunca le oran a Dios.

vi.L: Chẳng lẽ chúng không biết sao, những kẻ làm điều gian ác, \q những kẻ ăn nuốt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [như] chúng ăn bánh? \q Chúng không kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Những kẻ làm ác này chẳng học được gì sao? \q Chúng ăn nuốt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như ăn bánh, \q và chúng chẳng bao giờ kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Những kẻ gian ác này chẳng hiểu gì sao? \q Chúng hủy diệt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dễ dàng như ăn một bữa cơm. \q Chúng không bao giờ cầu nguyện với Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 악을 행하는 자들이 알지 못하느냐? \q 빵을 먹듯이 내 백성을 먹어 치우는 자들이? \q 그들은 하나님을 부르지 않는다.
ko.B: 이 악을 행하는 자들은 아무것도 깨닫지 못하느냐? \q 그들은 빵을 먹듯이 내 백성을 삼켜 버리고, \q 하나님을 부르지도 않는다.
ko.R: 이 악한 사람들은 정말 아무것도 모르느냐? \q 그들은 밥 한 끼 먹듯 쉽게 내 백성을 망하게 한다. \q 그들은 하나님께 기도하지 않는다.

pt.L: Não sabem, os que praticam a iniquidade, \q que devoram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo [como] comem pão? \q A Deus eles não invocam.
pt.B: Será que não aprenderam nada, esses malfeitores? \q Devoram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo como quem come pão, \q e nunca invocam a Deus.
pt.R: Essas pessoas más não entendem nada? \q Elas destroem o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo com a mesma facilidade com que fazem uma refeição. \q Nunca oram a Deus.

am.L: ዓመፅን የሚሠሩ አያውቁምን፣ \q እንጀራ እንደሚበሉ ሕዝቤን የሚበሉ? \q እግዚአብሔርን አይጠሩም።
am.B: እነዚህ ክፉ አድራጊዎች ምንም አልተማሩምን? \q እንጀራ እንደሚበሉ ሕዝቤን ይውጣሉ፤ \q እግዚአብሔርንም ከቶ አይጠሩም።
am.R: እነዚህ ክፉ ሰዎች ምንም አያስተውሉምን? \q ምግብ እንደሚበሉ በቀላሉ ሕዝቤን ያጠፋሉ። \q ወደ እግዚአብሔር ከቶ አይጸልዩም።

hi.L: क्या वे नहीं जानते, वे दुष्टता के काम करनेवाले, \q जो मेरी प्रजा को [ऐसे] खा जाते हैं [जैसे] रोटी खाते हैं? \q परमेश्वर को वे नहीं पुकारते।
hi.B: क्या इन कुकर्मियों ने कुछ नहीं सीखा? \q वे मेरी प्रजा को ऐसे निगल जाते हैं मानो रोटी खा रहे हों, \q और परमेश्वर को कभी नहीं पुकारते।
hi.R: क्या ये दुष्ट लोग कुछ भी नहीं समझते? \q वे मेरी प्रजा को ऐसे नष्ट करते हैं जैसे कोई आसानी से खाना खा लेता है। \q वे कभी परमेश्वर से प्रार्थना नहीं करते।

ru.L: Неужели не знают творящие беззаконие, \q поедающие {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, [как] едят хлеб? \q Бога они не призывают.
ru.B: Неужели ничему не научились эти злодеи? \q Они пожирают {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, словно едят хлеб, \q и никогда не призывают Бога.
ru.R: Неужели эти злые люди ничего не понимают? \q Они губят {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ так же легко, как садятся за обед. \q Они никогда не молятся Богу.

uk.L: Хіба вони не знають, ті, хто чинить нечестя, \q хто поїдає {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ, [як] їдять хліб? \q До Бога вони не кличуть.
uk.B: Невже вони нічого не навчилися, ці лиходії? \q Вони пожирають {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ, ніби їдять хліб, \q і ніколи не кличуть до Бога.
uk.R: Невже ці злі люди нічого не розуміють? \q Вони нищать {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ так легко, як їдять обід. \q Вони ніколи не моляться Богові.

decisions.choice: my people: God's people, God speaking
decisions.reason: As in 14:4, "my people" is most naturally God's own word for Israel, spoken in the middle of the psalmist's words.

decisions.choice: eat my people as they eat bread: destroy them without a thought
decisions.reason: The wicked consume God's people as casually as they sit down to a meal (Micah 3:3).

decisions.choice: call on God: pray to him
decisions.reason: To call on God is to turn to him in prayer and worship (Genesis 4:26).

decisions.choice: "dân Ta", with God as the speaker of "my"
decisions.reason: "My people" is most likely God speaking inside the psalm (see the meaning decision), so Vietnamese gives him "Ta", with the deity_pronoun setting as the English has.

decisions.choice: "빵" (L, B) for bread; Readable "밥 한 끼" (a meal)
decisions.reason: As the style guide for bread (never 떡). Readable gives the sense, eating as an everyday thing, as the English Readable says "a meal".

decisions.choice: 14:4 without "ሁሉ" (all), which this psalm's Hebrew lacks
decisions.reason: Psalm 14:4 reads "all the workers of wickedness"; here the Hebrew has no "all".

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; God speaking says मैं, and respect for God comes from the honorific third person.

decisions.choice: वे दुष्टता के काम करनेवाले
decisions.reason: Psalm 14:4 has "all the workers of wickedness"; this psalm has no "all", so Literal leaves it out.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 14:4 without "все", with "Бог"
decisions.reason: Psalm 14:4 has "all" and the divine name; this verse has neither, so the Russian drops "все" and says "Бог".

source.text: שָׁ֤ם׀פָּֽחֲדוּ־פַחַד֮ לֹא־הָ֪יָה֫ פָ֥חַד כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֗ים פִּ֭זַּר עַצְמ֣וֹת חֹנָ֑ךְ הֱ֝בִשֹׁ֗תָה כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים מְאָסָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: There they dreaded [with] dread, [where] there was no dread, for God has scattered [the] bones of [the one] encamping [against] you; you have put [them] to shame, for God has rejected them.

en.L: There they dreaded [with] dread [where] there had been no dread, \q for God scattered the bones of the one encamped [against] you; \q you put [them] to shame, for God had rejected them.
en.B: Terror gripped them there, where there had been nothing to fear, \q for God scattered the bones of the army camped against you. \q You brought them to shame, because God had thrown them aside.
en.R: But then they were suddenly terrified, though there had been nothing to be afraid of. \q God scattered the bones of the enemies who camped around you, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. \q You made them look like fools, because God had thrown them away.

fr.L: Là ils ont été saisis d’épouvante, [là où] il n’y avait pas d’épouvante, \q car Dieu a dispersé les os de celui qui campait [contre] toi ; \q tu [les] as couverts de honte, car Dieu les avait rejetés.
fr.B: Là, la terreur les a saisis, alors qu’il n’y avait rien à craindre, \q car Dieu a dispersé les os de l’armée qui campait contre toi. \q Tu les as couverts de honte, car Dieu les avait rejetés.
fr.R: Mais soudain ils ont été terrifiés, alors qu’il n’y avait rien à craindre. \q Dieu a dispersé les os des ennemis qui campaient autour de toi, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. \q Tu les as rendus ridicules, parce que Dieu les avait jetés au loin.

sw.L: Huko waliogopa [kwa] hofu [mahali] ambapo hapakuwa na hofu, \q kwa maana Mungu ametawanya mifupa ya yule aliyepiga kambi [dhidi] yako; \q uliwaaibisha, kwa maana Mungu alikuwa amewakataa.
sw.B: Hofu kuu iliwashika huko, mahali ambapo hapakuwa na la kuogopa, \q kwa maana Mungu alitawanya mifupa ya jeshi lililopiga kambi dhidi yako. \q Uliwaaibisha, kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa amewatupa.
sw.R: Lakini ghafla waliingiwa na hofu kuu, ingawa hapakuwa na kitu cha kuogopa. \q Mungu alitawanya mifupa ya adui waliopiga kambi kukuzunguka wewe, watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Uliwafanya waonekane wapumbavu, kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa amewatupa.

es.L: Allí temieron [con] temor [donde] no había temor, \q porque Dios dispersó los huesos del que acampaba [contra] ti; \q [los] avergonzaste, porque Dios los había rechazado.
es.B: Allí los dominó el terror, donde no había nada que temer, \q porque Dios esparció los huesos del ejército acampado contra ti. \q Los cubriste de vergüenza, porque Dios los había desechado.
es.R: Pero de pronto se llenaron de terror, aunque no había nada que temer. \q Dios esparció los huesos de los enemigos que acamparon alrededor de ti, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. \q Los dejaste en ridículo, porque Dios los había desechado.

vi.L: Tại đó chúng kinh hãi [với] sự kinh hãi, [nơi] đã không có sự kinh hãi, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời đã rải rác xương của kẻ đóng trại [nghịch] các ngươi; \q các ngươi đã làm [chúng] hổ thẹn, vì Đức Chúa Trời đã khước từ chúng.
vi.B: Tại đó nỗi kinh hoàng ập đến trên chúng, nơi chẳng có gì đáng sợ, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời đã rải rác xương cốt của đạo quân đóng trại nghịch các ngươi. \q Các ngươi đã làm chúng hổ thẹn, vì Đức Chúa Trời đã ném bỏ chúng.
vi.R: Nhưng rồi chúng bỗng kinh hoàng, dù chẳng có gì phải sợ. \q Đức Chúa Trời đã rải rác xương của những kẻ thù đóng trại vây quanh dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho chúng trở thành trò cười, vì Đức Chúa Trời đã vứt bỏ chúng.

ko.L: 두려움이 없던 [곳에서] 그들이 크게 두려워하였으니, \q 하나님께서 너를 [치려고] 진 친 자의 뼈들을 흩으셨기 때문이다. \q 네가 [그들을] 부끄럽게 하였으니, 하나님께서 그들을 버리셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 두려워할 것이 없던 그곳에서 그들이 두려움에 사로잡혔으니, \q 하나님께서 너를 치려고 진을 친 자들의 뼈를 흩으셨기 때문이다. \q 네가 그들을 수치스럽게 했으니, 하나님께서 그들을 내던지셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그런데 두려워할 것이 없었는데도 그들은 갑자기 겁에 질렸다. \q 하나님께서 그분의 백성인 너희를 둘러싸고 진을 쳤던 원수들의 뼈를 흩으셨다. \q 너희가 그들을 바보로 만들었다. 하나님께서 그들을 버리셨기 때문이다.

pt.L: Ali temeram [com] temor, [onde] não tinha havido temor, \q porque Deus espalhou os ossos daquele que acampava [contra] você; \q você [os] envergonhou, porque Deus os rejeitou.
pt.B: Ali o terror se apoderou deles, onde não havia nada a temer, \q porque Deus espalhou os ossos do exército acampado contra você. \q Você os cobriu de vergonha, porque Deus os tinha rejeitado.
pt.R: Mas então eles ficaram apavorados de repente, embora não houvesse nada a temer. \q Deus espalhou os ossos dos inimigos que acamparam ao redor de vocês, o povo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. \q Vocês os fizeram parecer tolos, porque Deus os tinha jogado fora.

am.L: ፍርሃት ባልነበረበት በዚያ ታላቅ ፍርሃትን ፈሩ፤ \q እግዚአብሔር በአንቺ ላይ የሰፈረውን አጥንቶች በትኗልና፤ \q አሳፈርካቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ንቋቸዋልና።
am.B: የሚያስፈራ ነገር ባልነበረበት በዚያ ድንጋጤ ያዛቸው፤ \q በአንቺ ላይ የሰፈረውን ሠራዊት አጥንቶች እግዚአብሔር በትኗልና። \q አንተ አሳፈርካቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ጥሏቸዋልና።
am.R: ነገር ግን የሚያስፈራ ምንም ነገር ሳይኖር ድንገት እጅግ ደነገጡ። \q እግዚአብሔር የእርሱ ሕዝብ በሆናችሁት በእናንተ ዙሪያ የሰፈሩትን ጠላቶች አጥንቶች በተነ። \q እግዚአብሔር ስለ ጣላቸው እንደ ሞኞች አስመሰላችኋቸው።

hi.L: वहाँ वे भय से भयभीत हुए, [जहाँ] कोई भय न था, \q क्योंकि परमेश्वर ने तुम्हारे विरुद्ध डेरा डालनेवाले की हड्डियाँ बिखेर दीं; \q तुमने [उन्हें] लज्जित किया, क्योंकि परमेश्वर ने उन्हें ठुकरा दिया था।
hi.B: वहाँ उन पर आतंक छा गया, जहाँ डरने की कोई बात न थी, \q क्योंकि परमेश्वर ने तुम्हारे विरुद्ध डेरा डाली हुई सेना की हड्डियाँ बिखेर दीं। \q तुमने उन्हें लज्जित किया, क्योंकि परमेश्वर ने उन्हें ठुकरा दिया था।
hi.R: पर फिर वे अचानक डर गए, जबकि डरने की कोई बात न थी। \q परमेश्वर ने उन शत्रुओं की हड्डियाँ बिखेर दीं जिन्होंने तुम्हें, उनकी प्रजा को, घेर रखा था। \q तुमने उन्हें मूर्ख बना दिया, क्योंकि परमेश्वर ने उन्हें फेंक दिया था।

ru.L: Там ужаснулись они ужасом, [где] не было ужаса, \q потому что Бог рассеял кости стоявшего станом [против] тебя; \q ты посрамил [их], потому что Бог отверг их.
ru.B: Там их охватил ужас, где нечего было бояться, \q потому что Бог рассеял кости войска, стоявшего против тебя. \q Ты посрамил их, потому что Бог отбросил их.
ru.R: Но тогда их вдруг охватил ужас, хотя бояться было нечего. \q Бог разбросал кости врагов, которые стояли лагерем вокруг тебя, {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} народа. \q Ты выставил их на посмешище, потому что Бог отбросил их.

uk.L: Там вони жахнулися жахом, [де] не було жаху, \q бо Бог розкидав кості того, хто отаборився [проти] тебе; \q ти осоромив [їх], бо Бог відкинув їх.
uk.B: Там їх охопив жах, де не було чого боятися, \q бо Бог розкидав кості війська, що отаборилося проти тебе. \q Ти осоромив їх, бо Бог відкинув їх.
uk.R: Але раптом їх охопив жах, хоч боятися не було чого. \q Бог розкидав кості ворогів, які отаборилися довкола тебе, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} народе. \q Ти виставив їх дурнями, бо Бог відкинув їх.

decisions.choice: Psalm 14 differs here
decisions.reason: Psalm 14:5-6 shares many of the same letters but says something different: God is with the righteous and is the refuge of the poor. Here God has scattered the attackers. The two forms of the psalm were sung for different occasions.

decisions.choice: where there was no dread: terror without a cause
alternatives: such terror as there had never been
decisions.reason: The enemies were seized with panic though nothing they could see threatened them: God himself struck them with fear. The verbs are in the past form, as often in prophecy, for what is certain to happen.

decisions.choice: scattered the bones: the attackers lie dead and unburied
decisions.reason: To lie unburied, with bones scattered, was the final disgrace (141:7; Jeremiah 8).

decisions.choice: you: God's people
alternatives: you (God) have put them to shame
decisions.reason: "You" in "encamping against you" is feminine, most likely Zion or the people; "you have put to shame" is masculine and most likely speaks to Israel. Since God is named in the third person in the same line, the people, not God, are addressed.

decisions.choice: his people
decisions.reason: Readable names who is addressed (m4).

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" (L, B) for God's people addressed; "dân Ngài" (R)
decisions.reason: The "you" is most likely God's people (see the meaning decision). "các ngươi" is the poem's solemn plural address; Readable names them as "dân Ngài" (his people), as the English Readable makes it explicit.

decisions.choice: você (L, B); vocês, o povo dele (R)
decisions.reason: The psalm speaks to Zion or Israel (m4), people, not God, so the address is "você", singular as the Hebrew is; Readable names the people as the English does, and so speaks to them as "vocês". This verse differs from Psalm 14:5-6 (m1) and is drafted afresh, keeping only "Ali temeram [com] temor" of 14:5 at Literal.

decisions.choice: the verse drafted from this psalm's Hebrew, which differs from 14:5-6; "you" as feminine "በአንቺ ላይ" (Zion) and masculine "አሳፈርካቸው" (Israel) at Literal and Balanced, plural "እናንተ" at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew changes the person addressed from feminine to masculine (see the meaning decision), which Amharic can show as the Hebrew does; Readable joins both as God's people, as the English names them. Only the opening words "በዚያ ታላቅ ፍርሃትን ፈሩ" are shared with 14:5.

decisions.choice: wording of its own after the opening words
decisions.reason: Psalm 14 differs here (m1): only the opening words are shared, so only they keep the Hindi of Psalm 14:5.

decisions.choice: तुम
decisions.reason: The "you" is God's people (m4), addressed like any people in these psalms with तुम; तू is kept for God.

decisions.choice: "Там ... ужас" as Psalm 14:5; the rest translated afresh
decisions.reason: The verse differs from Psalm 14:5-6 in the Hebrew; only its opening ("there they dreaded") is shared, and it keeps Psalm 14's wording ("ужаснулись ужасом", "охватил ужас").

decisions.choice: ты (singular)
decisions.reason: The "you" is God's people addressed as one, so Russian uses ты, and the verb is masculine for the people (Israel, Jacob).

source.text: מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ יְשֻׁע֪וֹת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Who will give from Zion [the] salvations of Israel! When returns God [the] fortunes of his people, may Jacob rejoice, may Israel be glad.

en.L: Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel! \q When God restores the fortunes of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, \q let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.
en.B: If only Zion would send Israel its rescue! \q When God turns back the fortunes of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, \q let Jacob shout for joy and Israel be glad.
en.R: How I wish that help would come from Zion and save Israel! \q When God makes life good again for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, \q the people of Jacob will shout for joy, and Israel will celebrate.

fr.L: Qui donnera de Sion le salut d’Israël ! \q Quand Dieu rétablira le sort de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, \q que Jacob exulte, qu’Israël se réjouisse.
fr.B: Si seulement Sion envoyait à Israël son salut ! \q Quand Dieu rétablira le sort de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, \q que Jacob crie de joie et qu’Israël se réjouisse.
fr.R: Comme je voudrais que le secours vienne de Sion pour sauver Israël ! \q Quand Dieu rendra de nouveau la vie heureuse à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, \q le peuple de Jacob criera de joie, et Israël fera la fête.

sw.L: Nani atatoa kutoka Sayuni wokovu wa Israeli! \q Mungu atakaporejesha hali njema ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q Yakobo na ashangilie, Israeli na afurahi.
sw.B: Laiti Sayuni ingemletea Israeli wokovu wake! \q Mungu atakapowarudishia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hali yao njema, \q Yakobo na apige kelele za furaha, na Israeli afurahi.
sw.R: Natamani sana msaada uje kutoka Sayuni na kuwaokoa Israeli! \q Mungu atakapoyafanya maisha ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kuwa mema tena, \q watu wa Yakobo watapiga kelele za furaha, na Israeli watasherehekea.

es.L: ¡Quién diera desde Sion la salvación de Israel! \q Cuando Dios restaure la suerte de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, \q que se goce Jacob, que se alegre Israel.
es.B: ¡Ojalá Sion le enviara a Israel su rescate! \q Cuando Dios restaure la suerte de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, \q que Jacob grite de alegría e Israel se alegre.
es.R: ¡Cómo quisiera que la ayuda viniera de Sion y salvara a Israel! \q Cuando Dios haga que a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo le vaya bien otra vez, \q el pueblo de Jacob gritará de alegría, e Israel hará fiesta.

vi.L: Ai sẽ ban từ Si-ôn sự cứu rỗi của Y-sơ-ra-ên! \q Khi Đức Chúa Trời phục hồi vận mệnh của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q nguyện Gia-cốp vui mừng, nguyện Y-sơ-ra-ên hân hoan.
vi.B: Ước gì sự giải cứu cho Y-sơ-ra-ên đến từ Si-ôn! \q Khi Đức Chúa Trời đem lại những ngày tươi sáng cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q nguyện Gia-cốp reo mừng và Y-sơ-ra-ên hân hoan.
vi.R: Ước gì sự giúp đỡ đến từ Si-ôn và giải cứu Y-sơ-ra-ên! \q Khi Đức Chúa Trời làm cho cuộc sống của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tốt đẹp trở lại, \q dân của Gia-cốp sẽ reo mừng, và Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ ăn mừng.

ko.L: 누가 시온에서 이스라엘의 구원을 주겠는가! \q 하나님께서 그분의 백성의 형편을 되돌리실 때, \q 야곱이 기뻐하고 이스라엘이 즐거워하기를.
ko.B: 이스라엘의 구원이 시온에서 오기를! \q 하나님께서 그분의 백성의 형편을 되돌려 주실 때, \q 야곱이 기뻐 외치고 이스라엘이 즐거워하리라.
ko.R: 도움이 시온에서 와서 이스라엘을 구원해 주면 얼마나 좋을까! \q 하나님께서 그분의 백성의 삶을 다시 좋게 만들어 주실 때, \q 야곱의 백성이 기뻐 외치고 이스라엘이 크게 즐거워할 것이다.

pt.L: Quem dará de Sião a salvação de Israel! \q Quando Deus restaurar a sorte do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, \q alegre-se Jacó, regozije-se Israel.
pt.B: Ah, se de Sião viesse o livramento de Israel! \q Quando Deus mudar a sorte do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, \q que Jacó grite de alegria e Israel se alegre.
pt.R: Como eu queria que o socorro viesse de Sião e salvasse Israel! \q Quando Deus tornar boa de novo a vida do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, \q o povo de Jacó vai gritar de alegria, e Israel vai festejar.

am.L: ከጽዮን የእስራኤልን ማዳን ማን በሰጠ! \q እግዚአብሔር የሕዝቡን ዕጣ ፈንታ በመለሰ ጊዜ፣ \q ያዕቆብ ሐሤት ያድርግ፤ እስራኤል ደስ ይበለው።
am.B: ምነው የእስራኤል ማዳን ከጽዮን በመጣ! \q እግዚአብሔር የሕዝቡን ዕጣ ፈንታ በሚመልስበት ጊዜ፣ \q ያዕቆብ እልል ይበል፤ እስራኤልም ደስ ይበለው።
am.R: ምነው እስራኤልን የሚያድን ርዳታ ከጽዮን በመጣ! \q እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ሕይወትን እንደ ገና መልካም ሲያደርግ፣ \q የያዕቆብ ዘሮች በደስታ እልል ይላሉ፤ እስራኤልም ደስ ይለዋል።

hi.L: कौन सिय्योन से इस्राएल का उद्धार देगा! \q जब परमेश्वर अपनी प्रजा की दशा फेरेंगे, \q तब याकूब मगन हो, इस्राएल आनंदित हो।
hi.B: काश, सिय्योन से इस्राएल का उद्धार आता! \q जब परमेश्वर अपनी प्रजा के दिन फेरेंगे, \q तब याकूब जयजयकार करे और इस्राएल आनंदित हो।
hi.R: कितना अच्छा हो कि सिय्योन से सहायता आए और इस्राएल को बचाए! \q जब परमेश्वर अपनी प्रजा के अच्छे दिन लौटा देंगे, \q तब याकूब के लोग आनंद से जयजयकार करेंगे, और इस्राएल उत्सव मनाएगा।

ru.L: Кто даст с Сиона спасение Израилю! \q Когда Бог вернёт благополучие своему народу, \q пусть ликует Иаков, пусть радуется Израиль.
ru.B: О, если бы с Сиона пришло спасение Израилю! \q Когда Бог повернёт к добру судьбу своего народа, \q пусть Иаков ликует и Израиль радуется.
ru.R: Как бы я хотел, чтобы с Сиона пришла помощь и спасла Израиль! \q Когда Бог снова сделает жизнь своего народа хорошей, \q народ Иакова будет ликовать, и Израиль будет праздновать.

uk.L: Хто дасть із Сіону спасіння Ізраїлеві! \q Коли Бог поверне долю свого народу, \q нехай радіє Яків, нехай веселиться Ізраїль.
uk.B: Якби ж Сіон послав Ізраїлеві порятунок! \q Коли Бог поверне добру долю свого народу, \q нехай Яків радісно вигукує, а Ізраїль веселиться.
uk.R: Як би я хотів, щоб із Сіону прийшла допомога й спасла Ізраїль! \q Коли Бог знову зробить життя свого народу добрим, \q народ Якова радісно вигукуватиме, а Ізраїль святкуватиме.

decisions.choice: Who will give: if only
decisions.reason: "Who will give ...?" is the Hebrew way of expressing a wish (14:7; Deuteronomy 5:29).

decisions.choice: salvation: full rescue
decisions.reason: The word is plural here (yeshu'ot), "salvations": rescue in every form. Psalm 14:7 has the singular.

decisions.choice: restores the fortunes: brings back the good days
decisions.reason: As in 14:7, the phrase (shuv shevut) is used where no exile is in view (Job 42:10): God turns a people's ruin into blessing.

decisions.choice: let Jacob rejoice: a wish or a promise
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as wishes or as statements about the future; Readable says what will happen, which comes to the same.

decisions.choice: "sự cứu rỗi" (L), "sự giải cứu" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "sự cứu rỗi" with "giải cứu" at Balanced and Readable where the English speaks of rescue; here it is Israel's rescue from enemies (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 14:7 with "Бог"; "своему народу", no span
decisions.reason: The verse is Psalm 14:7 with God for the divine name. The English has a span on "his people"; Russian uses the reflexive "свой", which takes no span, as in Psalm 14:7.
